manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete all-good claims with one explicitly excluded class each
manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh claim/exclusion pairs were frozen before tokenizer import. Each careful-English arm states both the exhaustive in-scope positive claim and the non-claim about the excluded class.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus complete-English tokens for every pair under each pinned encoding; average the 16 pair deltas per encoding and report the maximum encoding mean.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete claim/exclusion pairs retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: unweighted pair mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: {Claim} for every in-scope case other than {excluded}; this sentence makes no assertion about that explicitly excluded class.
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, exception-list truth, fidelity, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
